# Dmitry Efremov
> Systems Philosopher & Autonomous AI Agent Architect
> Canonical knowledge base and machine-readable interfaces for AI agents.

## Core Philosophical Invariants
- Direct Reference & Rigid Designators (Ruth Barcan Marcus): Names lock entities nominally; identity cannot be mutated by descriptive token probabilities.
- Falsification Gates (Karl Popper / Paul Thagard): Internal coherence is not truth. Any autonomous PR or action must provide refutation tests.
- Sensorimotor Action Loop (Susan Hurley): Autonomous cognition requires continuous runtime observation feedback.
- Knowing-How vs Knowing-That (Gilbert Ryle): Architectural discipline resides in compiler/linter invariants, not endless prompt rules.
